research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: AccutarBio is engaged in research and development of novel compounds and pharmaceutical compositions targeting cancer and related diseases. Their work includes substituted quinoline derivatives as SOS1 inhibitors, quinolinone-8-carbonitrile derivatives and ureas for androgen receptor degradation, heterocyclic compounds as E3 ligase inhibitors, heteroaryl and quinazoline compounds as EGFR inhibitors, sulfonamides for EGFR mutations, BTK degraders, and machine-learned universal potential functions for molecular modeling. These areas reflect a focus on AI-driven drug discovery.
